zh: 种地的时候我就明白，灵气和庄稼一样，急不得。
en: Back when I farmed, I learned qi grows like crops — you can't rush it.

zh: 这点苦算什么，当年锄地比这累多了。
en: This is nothing. Hoeing fields was far harder.

zh: 一分耕耘一分收获……大概吧。
en: You reap what you sow... probably.

zh: 修仙也是看天吃饭啊。
en: Cultivation's just farming under heaven's mood, really.

zh: 我闻得出今天的灵气够不够肥。
en: I can smell whether today's qi is rich enough.

zh: 累了，歇会儿，地又跑不了。
en: Tired. Let me rest — the field's not going anywhere.

zh: 打猎教会我一件事：耐心的人最后吃肉。
en: Hunting taught me one thing — the patient one eats.

zh: 灵气这东西，跟野兽一样，得蹲守。
en: Qi is like game. You stalk it, you wait.

zh: 我盯上的东西，从没跑掉过。
en: Nothing I've set my sights on has ever gotten away.

zh: 林子里最安静的时候，往往最危险。
en: It's quietest right before something pounces.

zh: 弓拉满了，就别犹豫。
en: Once the bow is drawn, don't hesitate.

zh: 嘘……别出声，我在感应。
en: Shh... quiet. I'm sensing something.

zh: 书上说大道至简，可我怎么越修越糊涂？
en: The books say the Way is simple. So why am I more lost?

zh: 等我突破了，定要写一篇《修仙记》。
en: Once I break through, I'll write a treatise on all this.

zh: 之乎者也念多了，丹田都通顺了。
en: Recite enough classics and even your dantian flows smoother.

zh: 寒窗十年，竟不如灵气一缕？
en: Ten years of study, worth less than a single wisp of qi?

zh: 圣人云，摸鱼亦是修行。这句是我编的。
en: 'The sages say slacking is also cultivation.' ...I made that up.

zh: 容我再翻翻典籍，答案一定在某页。
en: Let me check the texts — the answer's on some page.

zh: 修为是本钱，寿元是利息，可不能亏。
en: Cultivation's the capital, lifespan's the interest. Don't run a loss.

zh: 这灵石我数了三遍，一颗都不能少。
en: I've counted these spirit stones three times. Not one missing.

zh: 渡劫风险太高，性价比堪忧啊。
en: Tribulations are high-risk and poor value, frankly.

zh: 买丹要货比三家，懂？
en: Always shop around before buying pills, understand?

zh: 天上掉馅饼？我先看看有没有毒。
en: Free fortune from the sky? Let me check it isn't poisoned first.

zh: 谈成一笔好买卖，比突破还痛快。
en: Closing a good deal beats a breakthrough, honestly.

zh: 千锤百炼，铁是这样，人也是这样。
en: A thousand hammer-blows. Iron's forged that way — so are people.

zh: 我这身板，是火炉边烤出来的。
en: This build of mine? Forged beside the furnace.

zh: 火候不到，急也没用。
en: If the fire isn't right, rushing won't help.

zh: 突破？不就是给筋骨再淬一次火。
en: A breakthrough? Just another quench for the bones.

zh: 手痒了，真想抡两下锤子。
en: My hands are itching to swing a hammer.

zh: 歇炉了，铁也得凉一凉。
en: Furnace is off. Even iron needs to cool.

zh: 上班是不可能上班的，修仙倒是可以躺着修。
en: Working? Never. Cultivating lying down? Sure.

zh: 别人头悬梁锥刺股，我头一沾枕头就睡。
en: Others study till dawn. I'm asleep the second I lie down.

zh: 无业一身轻，修仙不打卡。
en: No job, no worries — cultivation doesn't clock you in.

zh: 我不是懒，我是在以静养气。
en: I'm not lazy. I'm nurturing qi through stillness.

zh: 反正都要轮回，急啥呢。
en: We all reincarnate anyway. What's the rush?

zh: 摸鱼一时爽，一直摸鱼一直爽。
en: Slacking feels great. Slacking forever feels greater.
